name: mods-image-preview
description: Shows thumbnails of pasted images above the prompt, in any terminal

renderer.title: Renderer
renderer.description: auto: kitty graphics in kitty and Ghostty, an overlay where the terminal advertises one, colored quadrant blocks elsewhere. window (Windows): a helper finds the thumbnail on screen and draws the original over it in any terminal or IDE. blocks, pixels, overlay and window force one renderer.

open.title: Open the original
open.description: off: open the original only when a thumbnail's number is pressed. ide: also open each pasted image in the connected IDE's editor (JetBrains, VS Code) without taking the focus. viewer: the IDE when connected, the system image viewer otherwise.
